svg.title: How Wakeshift works
svg.desc: Your app is on the left: your MCP server with the Wakeshift SDK attached, where the event is defined with defineEvent, call.subscribe() runs in your MCP tool and emit() runs from your backend. Their agent is on the right, such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot CLI, opencode, Antigravity, pi or Grok, and Wakeshift is in the middle. 1, subscribe: the agent calls your tool, which subscribes its conversation with Wakeshift. 2, emit: your backend emits the event to Wakeshift. 3, wake: Wakeshift wakes the subscribed conversation, through the agent's own MCP Events, Wakeshift's plugin (installed once, only if the user agrees) or a background listener, and the event arrives marked as coming from your app.
svg.text: installed once, only if the user agrees
